final: WITH per_name AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS driver_count FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(driver_count) AS avg_count FROM per_name) SELECT AVG(p.avg_points), AVG(p.driver_count), AVG(p.driver_count - o.avg_count) FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.driver_count > o.avg_count
